# Local GPUI Component patch

Upstream: gpui-component 0.7.3, crates.io source; original Apache license retained.

`src/diff/mod.rs`: defer the measured-viewport notification to `Window::on_next_frame`. A plain notification during the canvas draw does not schedule another frame. The initial line-width estimate otherwise remains visible until unrelated interaction: short split diffs occupy only part of the viewport. The existing `record_paint` change check prevents a continuous redraw loop. No source buffers or row caches are added.

Native regression: `scripts/windows-check-diff-width.ps1` checks the dark-theme submodule fixture screenshot. Before correction, the green row ends at 58% of the window width; run the same check after correction. This is a fixture-specific layout test, not a general screenshot comparator or scrolling test.

`src/diff/conflict.rs`: add `DiffFile::added(path, text)` for bounded untracked-file previews. Builds the original-empty/modified-added sides directly with one hunk, without serializing a temporary unified patch. Reuses the component line-range representation; empty files retain Added status. Application integration test: `tests/untracked_preview.rs` (desktop feature).

`src/highlighter/languages/rust/highlights.scm`: classify integer/float literals as `number` and escapes as `string.escape`, matching supported SyntaxColors slots. Keep boolean literals under `constant.builtin`, consistent with Rebased's Rust TextMate constant.language.bool scope. Source comparison: Rebased 4aec35256d765c217aa0d662b82ac4e860c396fd, plugins/textmate/lib/bundles/rust/syntaxes/rust.tmLanguage.json, TextMateDefaultColorsProvider.java, IslandSchemeDark.xml. Previously numbers fell back to constant purple and escape had no theme mapping.

`src/diff/{state,presentation}.rs`, `src/highlighter/{highlighter,wasm_stub}.rs`: propagate a per-preparation atomic cancellation flag. Resetting presentation cancels the previous generation; dropping DiffState cancels its running worker. Fresh Tree-sitter parsing uses a progress callback and resets resumable parser state; capture mapping checks cancellation between matches and hunks, inline work between line pairs. Cancelled presentation is discarded rather than published. The non-cancellable test wrapper remains cfg(test). Reference behavior: Rebased 4aec35256d765c217aa0d662b82ac4e860c396fd, DiffTaskQueue::abort and DiffViewerBase::dispose/abortRediff. Query compilation and one query-cursor step are not preempted. Windows component tests cover pre-cancelled preparation avoiding highlighter allocation, parser reuse after cancellation, and existing syntax/inline behavior; native rapid-cancellation latency remains a separate acceptance item.

Cancellation validation extension: a private generic progress observer allows tests to flip the actual atomic flag on Tree-sitter's third callback (production passes a no-op). The test asserts no tree/text/captures remain and compares subsequent Unicode input against a fresh parser. A GPUI test also checks token cancellation on presentation reset and entity drop. Native Windows log: artifacts/diff-parse-cancellation/inflight-tests.txt. This proves parser-phase cancellation and lifecycle notification, not all query/cross-thread scheduling latencies.

Split viewport correction (`src/diff/{mod,horizontal,state,selection}.rs`): split rows use half the visible body width, independently of the longest source line. A shared horizontal offset moves content inside each clipped column, with a scrollbar in each half, while preserving a single virtualized vertical list and shared documents/presentations. One-sided-only viewers use a full-width viewport. Unified mode retains a full-width content surface. Selection hit targeting uses clipped text bounds to prevent an overflowing left run from stealing right-side selection; source offsets and complete shaping bounds are retained for copying and width measurement. Reference: Rebased `4aec35256d765c217aa0d662b82ac4e860c396fd`, TwosideContentPanel, DiffSplitter and SyncScrollSupport. Native red/green screenshots are in artifacts/diff-split-width-{repro,fixed}; a GPUI renderer test checks clipping and a real right-side text drag. This does not reproduce JetBrains' draggable divider or independently clamped per-editor scroll positions; native wheel/scrollbar interaction remains manual verification.
